notes: B-57 (2026-10-29): 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a PLAYER OR PLANESWALKER, look at that many cards from the top of your library ... Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' Blocked by a 0/9 wall, the Harbinger deals its 4 damage only to the wall (a creature), so the trigger does not fire and the library keeps its order (filler Library 5 on top). Before the fix the recipient filter was universal: it looked at 4 and sent them to the bottom. The unblocked twin is garruks_harbinger.json.
